name: session-chat
description: Lets Claude Code and Codex sessions on the same machine ask each other for information and work in threads.

interface.shortDescription: Ask other Claude Code and Codex sessions in threads
interface.longDescription: Sessions on the same machine, Claude Code and Codex alike, share one chat under ~/.cache/session-chat. A session asks another by mentioning it in a thread, the other answers with a reply, and file and resource claims keep two sessions from editing the same thing. In Codex, hooks add new posts before your request, and a question that arrives while a session is idle starts a new turn there through codex queue.
defaultPrompt: Who else is working on this machine right now?
Ask the other session where its results are.
